summary: Local Ollama resilience residuals are implemented and the canonical Release gate passes. Remaining work is external validation and optional structure cleanup.
active_objective: Validate the completed Ollama resilience work in real runtime environments and address structure cleanup when scoped.
assumptions: Existing in-flight jobs keep their persisted max_retries; newly created jobs use the queue default of 5.
Automatic num_ctx means OnlyRag omits options.num_ctx and lets Ollama decide the effective context.
decisions: Keep endpoint and model choices primary; keep manual num_ctx, batch, timeout, and parallelism as advanced/custom controls with warning copy.
Fail exhausted translation placeholder validation non-retryably after local retries from the original source text.
Treat missing Ollama ps/version endpoints as degraded diagnostics, not as Ollama offline.
current_tasks: Validate live Ollama offline/restart behavior, interrupted model pulls, and large-context failures on a machine with representative models.
Validate long chat layout in the Windows WPF WebView shell at desktop and narrow widths.
Validate OCR GPU diagnostics on representative CPU-only, NVIDIA-driver-missing, runtime-missing, and runtime-ready Windows machines.
Review oversized files and split only where responsibility boundaries are clear.
next_tasks: Run signed installer lifecycle validation on a clean Windows verification machine when packaging is in scope.
blockers: Live Ollama resilience validation requires a local Ollama instance and enough disk/network capacity for representative model pulls.
NVIDIA/OCR validation requires representative Windows hardware or reliable mocked process/WMI outputs.
Signed installer lifecycle validation requires Inno Setup, signtool, a signing certificate, and a clean Windows verification machine.
risks: External/manual acceptance criteria cannot be proven from this workspace alone.
Local translation retries add up to 3.5 seconds per persistently invalid unit before non-retryable failure.
Existing queued jobs may retain older persisted retry limits until recreated.
oversized_files: several long PowerShell scripts under scripts/
structure_notes: No structural split was performed in this pass; behavior changes stayed scoped to existing modules.

external_services: Optional local or LAN Ollama endpoint

commands.test: dotnet test .\OnlyRag.sln --no-restore; Set-Location .\src\OnlyRag.Web; npm run test -- --run

last_completed_work: Implemented local Ollama resilience residuals, added audit artifact, and passed the canonical Release gate.
open_questions: Should oversized-file cleanup be handled now as a separate refactor task or deferred until after external runtime validation?
handoff_notes: Start external validation with live Ollama model pulls and interruption/retry scenarios, then verify WebView chat layout and representative OCR GPU states.
